card.name: Linking words before combined-use phrases
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "with" or "the" right before a phrase about using two drugs together, like "concurrent use" or "concomitant use". Found in drug-interaction sections.

modes.label: "the" before concomitant use
modes.description: The word "the" just before "concomitant use" or "use of" two named drugs.
modes.example: Due to additive pharmacologic effect,<< the>> concomitant use of benzodiaz

modes.label: "with" before concurrent use
modes.description: The word "with" after a list of adverse effects, before "concurrent use" of two drugs.
modes.example: heart failure, and cardiovascular collapse<< with>> concurrent use of verapamil and beta

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like "combined" and "joint" and away from "both".
card.plain: It spots the spot in an interaction warning where the text is about to say two drugs are used together.
